text_blocks.snippet: Chronic inflammation can be managed through a combination of lifestyle adjustments, medication, and in some cases, therapies like acupuncture. Lifestyle changes, such as adopting an anti-inflammatory diet and engaging in regular exercise, are crucial for long-term management. Medications like NSAIDs and corticosteroids can help alleviate symptoms, while biologic therapies may be used for more severe cases. Acupuncture can also be a beneficial addition to a comprehensive treatment plan.
